## Core Services

### Website Design

Custom-coded, mobile-first websites for local businesses. NLDS builds websites that communicate a clear offer, load fast, and give visitors a direct path to contact or inquiry. Sites are structured for local search without making ranking guarantees.

Inclusions across website packages:
- Custom design tailored to the business
- Mobile-first, responsive structure
- Clear navigation and service pages
- Fast load times and clean code
- Contact forms and quote requests
- On-page SEO structure (varies by package tier)

### Brand Visuals

Logo systems, branded graphics, and web imagery that give businesses a consistent presence across their website, Google Business Profile, and social platforms.

### Content Systems

Short-form video, social content, and launch assets that support local visibility. Intended for businesses that need ongoing content or a launch kit.

### Ongoing Website Support

Ongoing monthly maintenance for existing websites:
- Small content updates and text changes
- Image swaps and media updates
- Broken link checks and fixes
- Basic monthly site review
- Priority email support
- Light performance monitoring

Starting at $99/month.

### Business Starter Pack

An entry-level visual asset package for businesses that need branded materials quickly. Includes logo, Google Business Profile cover, social graphics, and business card template. One-time offer, no subscription required.

---

## Packages and Pricing

All prices are starting points. Final pricing depends on project scope, page count, content needs, revisions, and timeline.

### Website Packages

| Package | Starting Price | Notes |
|---------|---------------|-------|
| Starter Website | $499 | Basic SEO structure — titles, meta descriptions, header tags |
| Growth Website | $899 | Local SEO-friendly — location-targeted pages, service area copy |
| Premium Presence | $1,499 | Full SEO-ready — schema markup, optimized page hierarchy, local content |

Website add-ons:
- Extra page: $150–$250
- Landing page: $299–$499
- Basic SEO setup: $199+
- Google Business Profile cleanup: $149+
- Copywriting upgrade: $250+
- Image package: from $249
- Video package: from $349
- Monthly content support: custom

### SEO Clarification

Website packages include one-time on-page SEO setup only. This is not an ongoing SEO management service. No package guarantees search engine rankings.
